In this video, I feed Claude my actual three statement model and push it to build a summarized financials view, a full KPI dashboard, and a comparison dashboard with period selectors, prior year variances, and conditional formatting.

snippet.title: Kelly Mann's Founder's Journey | Miles Masterclass Trailer
snippet.description:
Innovation often begins with frustration, but turning that frustration into a real solution takes courage, discipline, and resilience.

In this Miles Masterclass course, Founder’s Journey, Kelly Mann shares her path from CPA to entrepreneur and the story behind building AuditMiner, a technology solution designed to improve 401(k) audits.

The course follows Kelly’s journey from leaving a traditional CPA role and building her own firm to identifying a major gap in the audit technology market. While searching for a better way to manage 401(k) audits, Kelly discovered that firms needed a solution to standardize diverse reporting formats and reduce manual audit friction.

Kelly explains how she used an auditor’s mindset to validate the problem, gather evidence from other CPAs, define the core issue, and build AuditMiner despite not having a technology background. The course also explores the importance of breaking large challenges into small steps, asking the right questions, building a support system, and prioritizing the problem before the solution.

A powerful part of the course is Kelly’s personal story of navigating stage three breast cancer while continuing to develop AuditMiner. Her experience highlights resilience, community, and the ability to find strength and purpose during difficult seasons.

Watch the full course to learn how Kelly Mann transformed professional frustration into innovation, built AuditMiner, and developed lessons that can guide aspiring entrepreneurs, firm leaders, and accounting professionals.

snippet.title: 8 Business Owners Compete For $100,000...
snippet.description:
Download your free scaling roadmap here: https://www.acquisition.com/roadmap-yt-d

If you’re new to my channel, my name is Alex Hormozi. I’m the founder and managing partner of Acquisition.com. It’s a family office, which is just a formal way of saying we invest our own money into companies. Our 10 portfolio companies bring in over $250,000,000+ per year. Our ownership stake varies between 20% and 100% of them. Given this is a YT channel, and anyone can claim anything, I’ll give you some stuff you can google to verify below.

How I got here…

21: Graduated Vanderbilt in 3 years Magna Cum Laude, and took a fancy consulting job.
23 yrs old: Left my fancy consulting job to start a business (a gym).
24 yrs old: Opened 5 gym locations.
26 yrs old: Closed down 6th gym. Lost everything. 
26 yrs old: Got back to launching gyms (launched 33). Then, lost everything for a 2nd time. 
26 yrs old: In desperation, started licensing model as a hail mary. It worked. 
27 yrs old: "Gym Launch" does $3M profit the next 6 months. Then $17M profit next 12 months.
28 yrs old: Started Prestige Labs. $20M the first year.  
29 yrs old: Launched ALAN, a software company for agencies to work leads for customers. Scaled to $1.7mmo within 6 months. 
31 yrs old: Sold 75% of UseAlan to a strategic buyer in an all stock deal. 
31 yrs old: Sold 66% of Gym Launch & Prestige Labs at $46.2M valuation in all-cash deal to American Pacific Group. (you can google it)
31 yrs old: Started our family office Acquisition.com. We invest and scale companies using the $42M in distributions we had taken + the cash from the $46.2M exit.
32 yrs old: Started making free content showing how we grow companies to make real business education accessible to everyone (and) to attract business owners to invest or scale their businesses. 
34 yrs old: I became co-owner of https://Skool.com, which is a platform for people to build communities online, making a living doing what they love, with people like them.
36 yrs old: I did a $106M book launch selling 3.6M copies of my $100M Money Models book, in 72 hours, breaking the Guinness world record for the fastest selling non-fiction book of all time.

Today: Our portfolio now does $200M/yr between 10 companies. The largest doing $100M/yr the smallest doing $5M per year. Our ownership varies between 20% and 100% ownership of the companies. Many of them we invested in early and helped grow (which is how we make our money - not youtube videos).

To all the gladiators in the arena, we’re all in the middle of writing our own stories. The worse the monsters, the more epic the story.

You either get an epic outcome or an epic story. Both mean you win. 

Keep crushing. May your desires be greater than your obstacles. 

Never quit,

Alex

snippet.title: I Asked QuickBooks' AI Chatbot to Be My CFO
snippet.description:
Learn more about Intuits new AI chatbot👇
https://quickbooks.intuit.com/?CID=social_qbo____acct_march_video_

I tested the new QuickBooks AI chatbot live to see if it can actually deliver CFO level insights or if it completely falls apart.

As a fractional CFO who's worked with over 100 fast growing companies, I had to know: can Intuit's AI in QuickBooks Online actually read your financials, explain what happened in the business, and give you real analysis? Or is this just more AI hype?

So I ran 6 tests, each one more complex than the last. I started with a simple revenue lookup, moved into quarterly OpEx comparisons, dug into transaction level vendor details, asked it to identify new subscriptions, had it generate a full CFO report... and then pushed it to create financial projections.
Some of the results genuinely surprised me. Others? Not so much.

In this video you'll see exactly how the QuickBooks AI chatbot performs when a real CFO puts it through its paces, what it gets right, where it breaks, and whether this thing can actually save you time during your month end close and analysis process.

04:15 Test #3: Transaction Intelligence 
06:28 Test #4: Detecting Transitions from New Vendors
07:16 Test #5:  Prepare a CFO Report

In this Miles Masterclass course, AI Enablement for Accounting Firms, Ellen Choi, AI enablement consultant and co-founder of Edgefield Group, provides a practical roadmap for accounting professionals and firm leaders looking to integrate AI into their organizations.

The course explores the foundations of automation, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI, helping learners understand how each technology fits into the accounting profession. Participants will gain insight into leading AI solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and industry-specific AI assistants. The course demonstrates how these tools can support research, content generation, client communication, workflow automation, business development, and decision-making across accounting firms.

Through real-world examples, Ellen showcases how firms are already using AI to automate routine tasks, accelerate research, generate client-ready deliverables, and optimize both practice management and growth initiatives.

snippet.title: Installing VirtualBox on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Setup | Step by Step Ultimate Guide 2026 #linux #ubuntu
snippet.description:
Installing VirtualBox on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Setup | Step by Step Ultimate Guide 2026 

Learn how to install VirtualBox on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS the right way with this complete step-by-step guide. This tutorial covers everything from downloading VirtualBox to fixing common dependency errors and broken packages during installation.

If you’ve been struggling with VirtualBox installation issues on Ubuntu, this guide will walk you through the exact commands and solutions to get it running smoothly.

Step 1: Download VirtualBox
Visit the official VirtualBox website and download the latest .deb package for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.

Step 2: Install VirtualBox
Open your terminal and run:
```
sudo dpkg -i virtualbox*.deb
```

🛠️ Fix Missing Dependencies / Errors
If installation fails due to missing dependencies or broken packages, follow these steps:
1. Enable Universe Repository
```
sudo add-apt-repository universe
sudo apt update
```
2. Install Required Dependencies
```
sudo apt install liblzf1 libqt5help5 libqt5opengl5 libqt5printsupport5 libqt5xml5 libtpms0
```
3. Fix Broken Packages
```
sudo apt --fix-broken install
```

💡 Pro Tips
- Always update your system before installing new packages
- Ensure you download the correct version for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
- Reboot after installation for best performance

snippet.title: Accounting No Longer A 'Professional Degree' Under One Big Beautiful Bill Act
snippet.description:
There’s been a lot of confusion about whether accounting—and several other fields—are losing their status as “professional degrees” under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. This change could dramatically impact federal loan limits, graduate program affordability, and even long-term career pipelines.

In this video, I break down what the bill actually changes, how the Department of Education is redefining “professional degrees,” and why accountants, nurses, educators, and other graduate students are worried. We’ll compare the old vs. new definitions, explain the new two-tier loan system, and dig into how this could affect the CPA pathway, master’s programs, and the broader profession.

This isn’t final yet — but the potential impact is big.
Let’s walk through it clearly so you know exactly what’s going on.

snippet.title: Transforming Client Services: People, Processes & AI with Michelle Voyer | Miles Masterclass Trailer
snippet.description:
Client advisory services are evolving from traditional workflows to AI-powered, human-led delivery models.

In this Miles Masterclass course, Transforming Client Services: People, Processes and AI, Michelle Voyer, Director and Client Advisory Services Leader at CohnReznick, explores how firms can modernize CAS by combining people, process, automation, and AI.

The course begins with the evolution of client services from paper-based workflows to cloud systems and now AI-driven operations. Michelle explains how tools like Microsoft Copilot, automation, and agentic AI systems can reduce administrative work, improve decision-making, and help CAS teams focus on higher-value advisory services.

The course also breaks down the difference between automation and true AI, showing how firms can use both to build scalable, exception-based workflows across month-end close, transaction categorization, reconciliations, onboarding, and client delivery.

Michelle also explores what it takes to build a future-ready CAS function, including industry alignment, global team structures, technology strategy, project management, change management, and disciplined implementation.

Watch the full course to understand how modern CAS teams can use AI, automation, and structured processes to deliver stronger client outcomes and build a more scalable advisory practice.

snippet.title: Power BI for Finance: Models, Metrics and Methods by Cristiano Galvao | Miles Masterclass Trailer
snippet.description:
Finance reporting should not depend on endless spreadsheet stitching.

In this Miles Masterclass course, Power BI for Finance: Models, Metrics and Methods, Cristiano Galvao shows finance professionals how to build a repeatable, refreshable reporting workflow using Power BI and Power Query.

The course begins with messy and inconsistent month-end files, then walks through how to turn them into a clean consolidation pipeline. Learners will see how Power Query can make the closure faster, more reliable, and less error-prone by reducing manual cleanup and repetitive reporting work.

Cristiano also covers the core skills that make finance reports more trusted and useful, including building a proper Date table, creating time intelligence measures such as MTD, YTD, and YoY, using credible external context from web data and PDFs, and structuring governed data models where relationships and measures work consistently across reports.

The course then moves into leadership-ready reporting, showing how to build clear budget vs actual views and executive dashboards that combine revenue, expense, and payroll into a single-page view of financial health.

Watch the full course to learn how Power BI can help finance teams move from manual reporting to scalable, insight-driven dashboards.

snippet.title: Who’s legally responsible for your AI Agent’s action? #aiagents  #ailaw
snippet.description:
Who's accountable for an agent's action? In the eyes of the law it's still you or your business. And ignorance of the law isn't an excuse either. 

As more agents, subagents are being deployed in the workspace, we have to be very, very cautious and have the governance to understand what happens when the agents end up doing something that either intentionally or unintentionally contravenes the law. Or creates an impact that could lead to a legal situation. 

I had a great conversation with Steve Major, King's Counsel and senior partner with Bennett Jones, on accountability and responsibility of agents and their actions in the eyes of the law in the latest episode of the AI Accelerator for Business show
